title: Fresh-solve starting-distance control at the near-root affine reanchor
fixed_affine_term: For all variants use qref=INPUT-V(anchor), HCOF=dq/dh(anchor), RHS=HCOF*anchor-qref. No term changes occur during a variant.
preregistered_gate: FAR_START_R1E15 must converge to the exact affine root within 1e-10 m.
NEAR_START_R1E15 is expected not to receive a MODFLOW convergence certificate while remaining within 1e-10 m of the affine root.
NEAR_START_R1E13 must converge and remain within 1e-10 m of the same affine root.
interpretation_logic: If the prediction holds, fresh-solve success in DSW09N/R is partly a starting-distance effect, not evidence that prepare_solve alone clears a hidden linear-solver state.
The near-root strict failure then follows from a nonzero affine residual below representable useful head correction but above the requested residual closure.
This does not remove the separately demonstrated MODERATE nonlinear under-relaxation history effect.
